summary: Iter16 regression on SSE crash-guard + AI World Court seal images. Backend: login+cookies, /auth/me, chat SSE (authed & guest) with delta+done, builder /generate SSE producing real project + gallery + quota — all PASS (6/6 relevant). Frontend: Court/Laws/Downloads all render court-seal.png (512x512, HTTP 200) at the expected data-testid selectors; Court submit flow returned a full VERDICT + REASONING ruling. Chat page streamed a real Luchii reply end-to-end — the 'Connection to the mesh failed' string NEVER appeared. guard_stream + keepalive wrapper is working as designed.

minor.issue: Public court endpoint responds with an SSE stream (text/event-stream), not a JSON body — fine for the UI (Court.jsx consumes it), but any client expecting JSON will fail. Only a documentation nit.

ui_bugs.issue: Submitting admin creds on /auth triggers POST that returns 409 (visible in console). URL stays on /auth. This was pre-existing (chat still works in guest mode, and cookies from previous session let /chat stream). Likely the form is calling /register instead of /login when a session already exists, or the toggle state isn't respected. Non-blocking for this review since chat streaming was verified.

verified_pass.downloads_court_seal: data-testid=downloads-court-seal, 512x512 loaded — sits above the 'Sign in to see your downloads' gate as expected
verified_pass.court_flow_e2e: Filled court-input + clicked court-submit — data-testid=court-ruling appeared with 'VERDICT ... REASONING ...' text
verified_pass.chat_stream_no_mesh_error: Sent 'In one sentence, what is a neural network?' — got full streamed Luchii reply; body scanned every 1s for 30s, 'Connection to the mesh failed' never present
verified_pass.backend_builder_generate: POST /api/builder/generate {prompt:'simple pong game',type:'game'} streamed to completion; done event carried project id; GET /api/builder/projects lists it
verified_pass.sse_keepalive_wrapper: guard_stream is emitting ': stream-start' and reaching graceful done — no dropped connections observed

not_executed: Voice endpoints heavy testing (per instruction; lazy-load acceptable)
action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Investigate the 409 shown on POST when submitting the /auth form with valid admin creds. UI stayed on /auth even though /api/auth/login via curl returns 200. May be a duplicate-submit or wrong endpoint in the register-vs-login toggle. Chat still worked (session already valid), so users are not blocked.
critical_code_review_comments: sse_utils.guard_stream is clean and correct — asyncio.Queue with 15s keepalive timeout and finally-cancel on the producer task. LGTM.
Court public endpoint returning SSE (not JSON) is fine as long as it's documented; consider mirroring the {delta,done} shape used by /api/chat for consistency.

success_rate.backend: 6/6 targeted PASS (1 court-JSON test failure was my test-script bug; UI verified live)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 builder project for admin during test_builder_generate_sse (simple pong game).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SSE crash-guard (sse_utils.guard_stream) is verified end-to-end for /api/chat and /api/builder/generate. All three AI World Court seal images are wired with the correct data-testid attributes on Court/Laws/Downloads and load a real 512x512 court-seal.png. Only lingering observation: Auth.jsx login form emits a 409 on submit even when creds are valid — the chat page still worked because cookies were already set, but the auth UX itself could not be re-verified this run. If a future test needs a fresh login via UI, may need to clear cookies first or use the /api/auth/login curl and inject cookies into playwright context.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all requested fixes verified working.
